attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Array of tenant objects to create

attributes.name: ReferenceId
attributes.description: Transient unique ID assigned by the developer. Used to reference individual tenant in the bulk-creation of tenants.

attributes.name: MoveInOn
attributes.description: The date the tenant physically started or will start occupancy. Dictates whether the "future" or "current" option is displayed in the status field.

attributes.name: UnitId
attributes.description: The unit the tenant occupies.

attributes.name: FirstName
attributes.description: The tenant's first name. Required if IsCompany is false or not provided.

attributes.name: LastName
attributes.description: The tenant's last name. Required if IsCompany is false or not provided.

attributes.name: MiddleName
attributes.description: The tenant's middle name

attributes.name: CompanyName
attributes.description: The display name of the tenant's company. Required if IsCompany is true.

attributes.name: IsCompany
attributes.description: Whether the tenant is a company (controls if the company name should be used as the name of the tenant). When true, CompanyName is required. When false, FirstName and LastName are required.

attributes.name: MoveOutOn
attributes.description: The date the tenant physically ended or will end occupancy. Dictates whether the "notice" or "past" option is displayed in the status field.

attributes.name: PrimaryTenant
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the tenant is the primary leaseholder for the occupancy. At least one PrimaryTenant is required per UnitId. Note: PrimaryTenant: true automatically sets the TenantType to Financially Responsible.

attributes.name: TenantType
attributes.description: The type of tenant. At least one tenant with TenantType Financially Responsible is required per UnitId.

attributes.name: Addresses
attributes.description: The tenant's address(es)

attributes.name: PhoneNumbers
attributes.description: The tenant's phone number(s)

attributes.name: Pets
attributes.description: Contains details about the tenant's pet(s)

attributes.name: Vehicles
attributes.description: Contains details about the tenant's vehicle(s)

attributes.name: Emails
attributes.description: The tenant's email address(es)

attributes.name: Tags
attributes.description: User-defined tag(s) that categorize the tenant

attributes.name: NextRentIncrease
attributes.description: The date of the tenant is eligible for a rent increase

attributes.name: LeaseStartDate
attributes.description: The day the lease agreement starts

attributes.name: LeaseEndDate
attributes.description: The last day of the lease agreement

attributes.name: LastLeaseRenewal
attributes.description: The date the last lease renewal agreement was started

responseFields.name: JobId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the bulk create job
